heater_candidates.name: Lucky Reptile Thermo Mat PRO HTP-10
heater_candidates.proposed_use: Comparison candidate. Two separate units need larger external mounting faces than the vessel bodies; do not bend them around a vessel.

facts: Specified uncovered surface temperature at room temperature is approximately 36 to 42 C, not a regulated bath temperature.
The manufacturer recommends a thermostat and prohibits bending the mat.
Protect the mat from damage, keep connections dry, do not immerse, and permit heat dissipation.
The overheat breaker is an emergency protection, not a temperature controller.
